metadata.why: Each Assignment spawns Visits as workers check in; Visit/VisitPhoto unmapped until visits.yml lands
Attendance may carry visitId reference for end-of-visit attendance writes
Chat may surface complaints (e.g., "log a complaint about Site X") which write to Complaint table
UPDATE_LIVING_DOC decisions emitted from chat write to LivingDoc
APPROVE_LEAVE decisions write LeaveRequest via accept route (P2)
UPDATE_LIVING_DOC decisions write LivingDoc via accept route (P2)
INITIATE_SWAP decisions write SwapRequest via accept route (P2)

OtpAttempt rows are auth-infrastructure-adjacent and currently unowned (`Device` was moved to `notifications.yml` on 2026-05-14; OtpAttempt left here as an unmapped orphan until an auth-infrastructure manifest exists)
WhatsApp send via Gupshup dispatcher handler (apps/backend/src/dispatcher/handlers/gupshup.ts) — external SaaS integration, not a manifest-mapped feature
Payroll recompute is a dispatcher consumer of Outbox topics (apps/backend/src/dispatcher/handlers/payroll.ts); no payroll.yml manifest yet
